title: Compatible shift squares and triangle diagrams for the pinned right-adjoint tensor comparison
statement: Let f:Z→Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Choose the ambient and open derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in a common localization universe, derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], derived direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and the shared derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Assume Rf* preserves quasi-coherent objects (hRf), O_Y is quasi-coherent (hO), and Lf*K⊗E is quasi-coherent for quasi-coherent K,E (hTensor). Fix a monoidal pullback structure, a pullback adjunction a, a right adjoint c to the quasi-coherent restriction of Rf*, and its adjunction adj. Put F(K)=Lf*K⊗c(O_Y), lifted to the quasi-coherent full subcategory. Let τ:F→c be a natural transformation satisfying, at every K, the pinned projection-isomorphism and adjunction-mate component formulas of [lem-sc-right-adjoint-tensor-comparison-natural]. Write t_K for its underlying ambient morphism. (1) For every integer n and quasi-coherent A,B with B.obj≅A.obj[n], there exist eF:F(B).obj≅F(A).obj[n] and ec:c(B).obj≅c(A).obj[n] with t_B≫ec.hom=eF.hom≫t_A[n]. (2) For each ambient distinguished triangle T and quasi-coherent A,B,C with T.obj₁≅A.obj, T.obj₂≅B.obj, T.obj₃≅C.obj, there exist distinguished triangles T₁,T₂ in D(O_Z), a triangle morphism m:T₁→T₂, and vertex isomorphisms eF_i:T₁.obj_i≅F(K_i).obj and ec_i:T₂.obj_i≅c(K_i).obj, where (K₁,K₂,K₃)=(A,B,C), such that m.hom_i=eF_i.hom≫t_(K_i)≫ec_i.inv for all three vertices. No invertibility of t_K, closure of its isomorphism locus, or preservation of coproducts is asserted.

proof.text: Let E=c(O_Y). K-flat representatives of derived pullback and derived tensor give the source functor K↦Lf*K⊗E its exact structure and shift comparison. Restrict the exact derived direct image to the quasi-coherent full subcategory. Transport its shift comparison through the given right adjunction to c: Hom(Rf*M,K[n]) identifies with Hom(M,c(K)[n]), so Yoneda gives c(K[n])≅c(K)[n]. The right-adjoint triangulated-functor theorem gives exactness of c with this comparison.

The pinned projection map is the pullback-adjunction mate of inverse monoidal comparison followed by the pullback counit. Invert it, compose tensoring the right-adjoint counit and the unitor, and take the right-adjunction mate. The specified formula for τ identifies it with this composite. Naturality of mates, monoidal coherence and the two counit identities identify its shifted component with its component conjugated by the source and target shift comparisons. Transport exact structures along comparison isomorphisms for differently presented adjunctions and monoidal structures. Compose these comparisons with the given B≅A[n] to get the first square.

Transport the arrows of the ambient distinguished triangle through its vertex isomorphisms to A,B,C, and view it in the quasi-coherent full subcategory. Apply the exact source and target functors to obtain distinguished triangles T₁,T₂. Naturality gives the first two squares of their comparison morphism; the shift square from the preceding step gives its third square, including the connecting arrow. Written using the six vertex isomorphisms, its components are eF_i.hom≫τ_i.hom≫ec_i.inv. This construction does not assume any τ_i invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem rightAdjointTensorComparison_diagrams
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (hRf : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z,
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E.obj))
    (hO : schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y)))
    (hTensor : ∀ (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z),
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ E.obj))
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    (a : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z)
    (adj : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) hRf ⊣ c)
    (τ : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Z).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ⋙ derivedPullback f ⋙
        tensorRight (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)
      (fun K ↦ hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩))
      ⟶ c)
    (hτ : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
      ∃ pf : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
            (((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ≅
          K.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
        pf.inv = (a.homEquiv _ _)
          ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (derivedPullback f) K.obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)).inv ≫
            (derivedPullback f).obj K.obj ◁ a.counit.app (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ∧
        τ.app K = ((adj.homEquiv
          ⟨((derivedPullback f).obj K.obj) ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj,
            hTensor K (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩)⟩ K)
          (ObjectProperty.homMk (pf.hom ≫
            K.obj ◁ (adj.counit.app ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).hom ≫ (ρ_ K.obj).hom)))) :
    (∀ (A : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (n : ℤ)
      (B : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y), Nonempty (B.obj ≅ A.obj⟦n⟧) →
      ∃ (eF : ((derivedPullback f).obj B.obj ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj) ≅
          (((derivedPullback f).obj A.obj ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj)⟦n⟧))
        (ec : (c.obj B).obj ≅ (c.obj A).obj⟦n⟧),
        (τ.app B).hom ≫ ec.hom =
          eF.hom ≫ (shiftFunctor (schemeDerivedCategory Z) n).map (τ.app A).hom) ∧
    (∀ (A B C : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
      (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Y)),
      T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles →
      Nonempty (T.obj₁ ≅ A.obj) → Nonempty (T.obj₂ ≅ B.obj) →
      Nonempty (T.obj₃ ≅ C.obj) →
      ∃ (T₁ T₂ : Pretriangulated.Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Z)) (m : T₁ ⟶ T₂),
        T₁ ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles ∧
        T₂ ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles ∧
        ∃ (eF₁ : T₁.obj₁ ≅ ((derivedPullback f).obj A.obj ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj))
          (ec₁ : T₂.obj₁ ≅ (c.obj A).obj)
          (eF₂ : T₁.obj₂ ≅ ((derivedPullback f).obj B.obj ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj))
          (ec₂ : T₂.obj₂ ≅ (c.obj B).obj)
          (eF₃ : T₁.obj₃ ≅ ((derivedPullback f).obj C.obj ⊗ (c.obj ⟨𝟙_ _, hO⟩).obj))
          (ec₃ : T₂.obj₃ ≅ (c.obj C).obj),
          m.hom₁ = eF₁.hom ≫ (τ.app A).hom ≫ ec₁.inv ∧
          m.hom₂ = eF₂.hom ≫ (τ.app B).hom ≫ ec₂.inv ∧
          m.hom₃ = eF₃.hom ≫ (τ.app C).hom ≫ ec₃.inv)
